setupSteps: 3. Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN in the Code and Email nodes.
4. Copy the Webhook URL and register it in ISC → Integration Hub → Webhooks with event 'schedule.weekly_kpi_digest'.
5. ISC fires this webhook every Monday — no cron needed in n8n.

nodeDetails.detail: Listens for the schedule.weekly_kpi_digest event on path /isc-weekly-kpi-digest
Builds an HTML table from the kpis[] array — columns: KPI label, value (colour-coded by status), target, and trend arrow
Sends subject: "Your Weekly KPI Digest — Week of {weekOf}" to body.recipientEmail
